geo_aeo.answer_first_block: Temporal is an orchestration platform for microservices utilizing an Event Sourcing replay model to ensure workflows recover state seamlessly after system crashes. In Go, Temporal Workflows mandate absolute determinism (no unmanaged goroutines, native random calls, or system clocks) to enable accurate state reconstruction.
